answer: Bonded escrows make identities costly: when k coordinated identities equivocate, pairwise evidence can expose up to k(k−1)/2 correlated offenses, so penalties scale as O(k²), not linearly. Detection also applies asymmetric depreciation to the swarm’s locked capital, imposing an exponential-in-k loss multiplier; splitting stake cannot dilute the risk. A sonnet-like consensus signal or shale reserve cannot erase evidence of coordinated behavior.
